l.i: permutans, dextram quidem in iuniori, sinistram

main_text.l: vero in senioris caput imponens. Et Tertullianum
in ista ipsa re: Impositis & intermutatis manibus

l.i: benedixit, & quidem ita transversim obliquatis in-
ter se, ut Christum deformantes, jam tunc portenderent

main_text.l: Christum deformârunt illæ manus? imò Crucem: & sic
mihi libido aliquando legere: sed refræno,
Crux Andreana. — Vti & in Abdia lib. xxx.

page.notes: Woodcut of a figure on an X-shaped (St Andrew's) cross, captioned "Crux Andreana" in the left margin. Marginal notes: "De Baptism. cap. VIII." and "In Comment. Græc." right; "Vti & in Abdia lib. xxx." left. Some letters in the body are doubtful due to faint print; the asterisk after "*legas" and the reading of "Achaiâ" are uncertain. The printed text contains the marginal-note tags in lowercase italic and is transcribed as printed.
